maps.name: Ember Rhythm
maps.intent: Learn to pump two rollers, carry that rhythm into a visible gap, then repeat with a quicker pop.
maps.signature: Pumping rhythm becomes flight timing; a broad tabletop teaches the motion before the first void.

maps.name: Azure Terrace
maps.intent: Climb toward a visible terrace, rehearse an elevated catch, then reveal the skyline with one high spring.
maps.signature: A 10-unit spring lift unlocks an upper route; the final terraced descent releases the tension.

maps.name: Fuse Halo
maps.intent: Teach curved takeoff, show the explosive connector and loop, then give the player a safe ground return.
maps.signature: One boosted one-use loop is the landmark; the connector disappears only after full-bike clearance.

maps.name: Skyline Courier
maps.intent: Teach the high bridge route, then use an optional crest barrel for a short aerial delivery onto a readable catch.
maps.signature: A barrel-assisted skybridge pop is the centerpiece; the ground route remains continuous below it.

maps.name: Broken Horizon
maps.intent: Build a sense of increasing horizontal distance, then let a spring carry the bike across the central canyon.
maps.signature: A 36-unit void and long spring arc with three obstacle coins create the widest single reveal so far. Extended with higher-tier transfers and technical obstacles.

maps.name: Basalt Descent
maps.intent: Teach braking and descending alignment in successive lower catch basins, separated by stabilization shelves.
maps.signature: A downhill route built around horizontal drops and sloped catches; braking, rather than boosts, sets the pace.

maps.name: Quarry Cadence
maps.intent: Alternate deliberate low-speed ledges with a faster optional loop so speed control becomes the central skill.
maps.signature: Curb, double curb, elevated catch, then a round ignition halo; each speed regime has its own reset. Extended with higher-tier transfers and technical obstacles.

maps.name: Cloud Observatory
maps.intent: Make the upper destination the visual goal, reach it through a tall spring reveal, then explore its raised bridge.
maps.signature: A 14-unit lift leads to a raised roller bridge with an optional barrel reprise.

maps.name: Redline Viaduct
maps.intent: Build speed through compression, spend it on a tall optional loop, recover, then test one long manual gap.
maps.signature: A round ignition halo and long-clear gap form two separated peaks, with a downhill bridge between them.

maps.name: Crown Relay
maps.intent: Extreme finale: combine precision manual catches, technical control and maximum-difficulty spring/loop sequences across an extended route.
maps.signature: Triple ignition crown, summit lift and frontier crossing followed by expert ruin control.

maps.name: Tidepool Run
maps.intent: Read gentle wave rhythms, cross the first tidal channel and settle on broad sandbanks.
maps.signature: Low rollers lead into a low spring skim; short manual hops echo the incoming tide.

maps.name: Broken Boardwalk
maps.intent: Carry momentum between detached pier sections, alternating elevated transfers with ground recovery.
maps.signature: Three different pier profiles culminate in a barrel pop above the shoreline.

maps.name: Coral Causeway
maps.intent: Alternate low reef shelves and short channels before a raised spring transfer.
maps.signature: A dipping spring launches from a reef basin onto an upper coral shelf.

maps.name: Sea Cliff Descent
maps.intent: Climb a coastal bluff, then control descending speed across a sequence of lower catches.
maps.signature: Three descending transfers are separated by braking shelves and a sheltered cove.

maps.name: Lagoon Express
maps.intent: Build horizontal momentum and spend it on two separated lagoon crossings.
maps.signature: A low manual channel precedes a long spring crossing, followed by a curved reprise. Extended with higher-tier transfers and technical obstacles.

maps.name: Lighthouse Spiral
maps.intent: Climb toward the lighthouse, commit through its explosive ring and descend by the outer shore.
maps.signature: A raised spring approach introduces one ring with a revealed curved exit.

maps.name: Storm Pier
maps.intent: Link broken high platforms and changing wave rhythms while managing landing speed.
maps.signature: Detached double-hump piers lead to a roller spring crossing and a long final gap. Extended with higher-tier transfers and technical obstacles.

maps.name: Hidden Cove
maps.intent: Use alternating basins and elevated catches to reveal a hidden upper beach.
maps.signature: A deep scoop and a high spring connect two coves separated by a rock wall.

maps.name: Twin Harbor Rings
maps.intent: Prepare for two consecutive explosive loops, then use the harbor bridge as a controlled exit.
maps.signature: Two independent ignition rings connect directly across the harbor landmark.

maps.name: Archipelago Finale
maps.intent: Extreme finale: combine precision manual catches, technical control and maximum-difficulty spring/loop sequences across an extended route.
maps.signature: Triple island rings, summit launch, frontier channel and precision island ruins.

maps.name: Dune Caravan
maps.intent: Establish desert rhythm with rounded dunes, compression basins and one broad manual crossing.
maps.signature: Alternating dune crests build momentum into a low gap and a final long tabletop.
maps.setting: Rolling dunes along a caravan trail

maps.name: Sandstone Steps
maps.intent: Alternate technical ledges and elevated catches while keeping recovery between changes in speed.
maps.signature: Unequal ruin stairs feed a high shelf transfer, followed by a descending terrace exit.

maps.name: Oasis Circuit
maps.intent: Descend into an oasis, cross its basin and rise onto the surrounding dunes.
maps.signature: A dipping long spring and a high spring trace an up-and-out oasis route.
maps.setting: Palm oasis in a dune basin

maps.name: Red Canyon Run
maps.intent: Manage speed through lower canyon catches and a wide spring transfer between canyon walls.
maps.signature: Two controlled drops frame a long horizontal crossing across the canyon mouth.

maps.name: Mirage Flats
maps.intent: Contrast long low approaches with sudden distant catches and broad recovery shelves.
maps.signature: A low skim rehearses the much longer crossing toward the apparent mirage. Extended with higher-tier transfers and technical obstacles.
maps.setting: Salt flats and distant dune islands

maps.name: Buried Twin Rings
maps.intent: Climb out of buried ruins, pass two ignition arches and return through stepped desert ground.
maps.signature: Two directly linked explosive loops form the central paired-arch landmark.

maps.name: Caravan Skyway
maps.intent: Alternate mesa rises and changing bridge profiles before a spring crossing to the caravan road.
maps.signature: A high lift unlocks the skyline bridge; a descending spring returns to the lower trail. Extended with higher-tier transfers and technical obstacles.

maps.name: Sun Temple
maps.intent: Combine technical ruin steps, high catches and a summit lift to climb the sun temple.
maps.signature: A summit spring reaches the temple crown; a controlled drop resolves the ascent.
maps.setting: Tiered temple above a dune plateau

maps.name: Sandstorm Rhythm
maps.intent: Read irregular terrain rhythms and change speed deliberately between precision transfers.
maps.signature: Broken dune timing culminates in a roller spring crossing, followed by one precise final gap.

maps.name: Dune Crown Finale
maps.intent: Extreme finale: combine precision manual catches, technical control and maximum-difficulty spring/loop sequences across an extended route.
maps.signature: Triple desert crown, summit lift, frontier flight and an expert manual ruin gauntlet.
maps.setting: Three ancient arches at the desert frontier
